FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At TaxWise Accounting Services, we specialize in providing comprehensive tax preparation and accounting services tailored for individual taxpayers and small businesses with straightforward financial needs. Our operations include accurate and timely tax filing, detailed bookkeeping, and essential financial recordkeeping to ensure compliance with local, state, and federal regulations. We commit to maintaining high professional standards by ensuring our staff holds relevant certifications and licenses, and we apply rigorous data security measures to protect sensitive client information. Our focus is on delivering clear written client engagement agreements that outline the scope of services and associated fees, fostering transparency and trust in our client relationships. Additionally, we conduct regular internal audits to ensure compliance and quality control in our accounting practices. It is important to note that we do not provide financial planning or investment advisory services, as we aim to operate within the scope of standard tax preparation and accounting.
